welcome.title: Let's set up your day.
welcome.text: Nine short steps, and none of them is binding. Everything stays changeable later.

rituals.iosHint: On the iPhone, put the app on the home screen first. Only then can reminders reach you.
rituals.reminderHint: Reminders stay quiet at night. The weekly reset looks back on {{day}}.
